{{Quote|Wha&mdash;|Orso Meeto's reaction upon seeing Dass Jennir in his residence|<ref name="DT4" />}}
The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Orso Meeto]] owned an '''apartment''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] tracked Meeto to his apartment to learn the location of a slave he'd sold named [[Resa Greenbark]]. After Meeto told Jennir whom he sold the slave to, Jennir killed Meeto and fled the apartment.

==Description==
An apartment<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|302|Meeso, Orto}}</ref> was owned by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Orso Meeto]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orvax IV]]. The apartment included at least one room which included a balcony as well as a floor mounted [[Holoprojector/Legends|device]] capable of showing [[Hologram/Legends|Holograms]] located next to a chair from which to view the displays. A vase was also displayed on a small table next to the double doored entrance into the apartment.<ref name="DT4" />

==History==
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Meeto returned to [[Gender/Legends|his]] residence after selling a [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] named [[Resa Greenbark]] to one of his regular customers, a wealthy [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Dezono Qua]]. Once inside his residence Meeto began viewing a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of a female Chagrian dancing whilst two guards were stationed outside of his door. As the slaver enjoyed the hologram, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] scaled the side of the building to reach Meeto, having spent the best part of an afternoon learning Meeto's name and the residence's location. Upon reaching the balcony of the room Meeto was in Jennir climbed through and threatened Meeto at [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]&ndash;point, demanding the slaver [[Youngling/Legends|tell him who bought Resa]]. The Chagrian gave Jennir the information he was looking for, but to prevent Meeto telling Qua he was in danger, Jennir killed Meeto. The gunfire alerted the guards who entered the room and began firing at Jennir, however the Jedi tied a rope that he brought along to the balcony and leapt off, successfully escaping the guards afterwards.<ref name="DT4" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meeto's residence first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Dark Times 4|''Dark Times'' 4]], which was the fourth issue of both the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times]]'' comic book series and it's first story arc, [[Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere|''The Path to Nowhere'']]. The issue was written in [[2007]] by [[Randy Stradley]] under the name Mike Harrison and illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]]. The apartment was later mentioned in Meeto's entry in the [[2009]] sourcebook, ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
